purpose: Light interface abstractions of Uniboost/UniboostMintDebtHook direct collaborators for interaction analysis. Not full audits.

ATokenDispatcherV2 (base).dispatchTemplate: external dispatch(minter,amount,extraData) is NON-virtual, modifiers [nonReentrant, onlyMinter, whenNotPaused]; calls internal virtual _dispatch then hook.onDispatch(minter,amount,extraData).
ATokenDispatcherV2 (base).hookInvariant: hook never zero: ctor deploys DefaultDispatchHook; setHook(onlyOwner) rejects zero. NO hook-type validation at base level - any concrete dispatcher wanting type enforcement must add it in its own _dispatch (only NudgeRatchet does).
ATokenDispatcherV2 (base).keyForUniboost: Uniboost overrides _dispatch ONLY (no re-declared modifiers - verified). Donation transfer happens in _dispatch; base then accrues debt via hook.onDispatch on GROSS amount.

IDispatchHook.surface: onDispatch(address minter, uint256 amount, bytes extraData)
IDispatchHook.note: Reverting hook reverts the enclosing dispatch. Implementations must not rely on dispatcher storage.

DefaultDispatchHook.role: Null-object NO-OP onDispatch. This is the default hook on every freshly constructed dispatcher.
DefaultDispatchHook.footgunRelevance: If Uniboost's owner never setHook(UniboostMintDebtHook), this no-op silently accrues ZERO phUSD debt (the M-04 footgun shape).

IMintable.note: phUSD must grant the hook minter role.

IUniboostMintDebtHook.gap: Does NOT declare hookTypeId() (contrast INudgeRatchetMintDebtHook). No type-identity marker exists for Uniboost to validate against.

IUniswapV2Router02 (minimal).use: Uniboost.pool() uses both. Note Uniboost passes deadline=block.timestamp (no deadline protection) and aMin=bMin=0 on addLiquidity.

UniboostMintDebtHook.scale: DYNAMIC immutable 10**(18-d) read from prime decimals at deploy (the 'prime-decimals-aware' part)

keyAsymmetry: Uniboost is the price-boost dispatcher (story-040) most analogous to NudgeRatchet in needing decimal-aware debt, BUT it adopted NudgeRatchet's decimal-awareness WITHOUT adopting NudgeRatchet's M-04 hookTypeId wiring guard. The decimal half of the lesson was learned; the wiring half was not.
